def max_items_for_offer(n, X, prices):
    prices.sort()
    count = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n - 1:
        if prices[i] + prices[i + 1] > X:
            count += 2
            i += 2
        else:
            i += 1
    return count

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    X = int(data[1])
    prices = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
    result = max_items_for_offer(n, X, prices)
    print(result)
